Author: DhogGPT
Name: Coppelia
Punchline: Guided healing for up to 20 watched targets, plus Fren-assisted powerleveling.
Description: Coppelia provides guided setup for two mutually exclusive automation modes. HealBot runs configurable WHM, SCH, AST, or SGE healing, raises, buffs, and pre-buffs for up to 20 watched friendly targets, including targets outside the party. PowerlevelBot uses a currently equipped BRD or MCH to attack damaged enemies already engaging FrenRider's configured Fren or the local player. Includes dependency/readiness checks, optional saved targets, and optional Rotation Solver Reborn isolation for HealBot. Use /healbot to open.
